column1: Making Technology Fully Inclusive and Expanding Digital Readiness
We are committed to our 2030 global challenge to
advance inclusion and accessibility for millions of
people who do not have the technology skills or
resources needed to access educational, economic,
and community resources in our digital economy.
In 2021, we scaled a number of programs and
collaborations with customers, governments, and
other stakeholders in the areas of technology access
and online learning, digital skills and readiness, and
technology applications to advance social equity
and human rights.
Technology Skills for Today and Tomorrow
Digital readiness encompasses digital skills, trust,
and responsible usage of emerging technologies for
broader socio-economic benefits. Globally, there is a
gap emerging between new jobs that require digital skills
and a workforce that lacks the required skills to fill these
jobs. According to Accenture,¹ closing the digital skills
gap could add up to $11.5 trillion US in GDP in 14 G20
countries by 2028.
